findings.source_passage: New Bedford beats all Water Street and Wapping. In these last-mentioned haunts you see only sailors; but in New Bedford, actual cannibals stand chatting at street corners
findings.why_it_matters: The comparative boast 'New Bedford beats all Water Street and Wapping' is the rhetorical pivot of the paragraph and carries Ishmael's mock-civic-pride voice; it disappears entirely in the draft, which jumps straight to the cannibals.
findings.suggested_fix: Restore 'New Bedford beats all Water Street and Wapping' before the cannibal sentence; it is short and metrically distinctive.

findings.source_passage: Look there! that chap strutting round the corner. He wears a beaver hat and swallow-tailed coat, girdled with a sailor-belt and sheath-knife. Here comes another with a sou'-wester and a bombazine cloak.
findings.why_it_matters: These vivid thumbnail sketches are the rhetorical payoff of the 'green Vermonters' passage—they make the bumpkin type concrete and comic. Their erasure collapses the scene into abstraction.
findings.suggested_fix: Reinsert the two street-portrait sentences ('Look there! … sou'-wester and a bombazine cloak') before the transition to the bumpkin-dandy paragraph.

findings.source_passage: Had it not been for us whalemen, that tract of land would this day perhaps have been in as howling condition as the coast of Labrador. As it is, parts of her back country are enough to frighten one, they look so bony.
findings.why_it_matters: This is Ishmael's signature ironic civic boosterism—crediting whalemen for civilizing a wasteland—which frames the 'patrician houses' observation that follows. Without it the wealthy-New-Bedford passage loses its rhetorical setup.
findings.suggested_fix: Restore at least the Labrador comparison and the 'back country … so bony' sentence to preserve the ironic contrast with the opulent gardens.

findings.source_passage: The streets do not run with milk; nor in the spring-time do they pave them with fresh eggs.
findings.why_it_matters: This biblical anti-Canaan joke ('land of oil, true enough: but not like Canaan') needs its comic denial list to land; the draft keeps the Canaan reference but drops the punchline.
findings.suggested_fix: Add the two denial clauses ('streets do not run with milk… pave them with fresh eggs') after 'no Canaan' to restore the joke.

findings.source_passage: Whence came they? how planted upon this once scraggy scoria of a country?
findings.why_it_matters: The rhetorical question is the formal device that sets up the 'Go and gaze' answer; its omission makes the transition feel abrupt and removes Ishmael's mock-Socratic pose.
findings.suggested_fix: Restore the two-part question ('Whence came they? how planted upon this once scraggy scoria of a country?') before the 'Go gaze' sentence.

summary: No high-severity signature losses; three medium findings (the 'New Bedford beats all Water Street' pivot, the street-portrait vignettes, and the Labrador/Canaan ironic framing) represent meaningful voice-flattening but do not individually or collectively meet the regeneration threshold given the two low-severity items.
